_vars.bg: on completely flat solid warm cream background color #F5EFE3, no texture no gradient pure single flat color background
_vars.style: watercolor wash over visible pencil sketch underdrawing, figurative illustration, warm intimate painterly quality, Persian blue and warm earth tones, expressive brushwork, pencil lines remain visible beneath the wash
_vars.neg: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, cartoon, flat vector, clipart, generic, text, logos, dark background, textured background, gradient background, watercolor paper texture, parchment texture, canvas texture

prompt: A young Black girl, about 7 years old, sitting cross-legged on the ground outdoors, eyes gently closed, hands folded in her lap in prayer. A few simple wildflowers grow beside her, rendered with spare watercolor strokes. The figure is centered, peaceful, intimate scale.

An elderly South Asian woman with gray hair, seated on a low wooden stool, holding up a painted card showing a nine-pointed star. She explains it warmly to someone off-frame. Her expression is patient and kind. A suggestion of a tree branch arches behind her in thin pencil lines.

A white boy, about 8, lying on his stomach in the grass, drawing geometric shapes carefully in a notebook. His face shows total absorption. The grass around him is suggested with loose green watercolor strokes, just a few blades.
A young Indigenous girl, about 6, mid-song, mouth open wide, arms slightly lifted by her sides. Her expression is joyful and unselfconscious. Simple prairie flowers loosely sketched around her feet.
An Arab boy, about 9, standing upright with one hand pressed to his chest, eyes closed, lips gently moving — reciting a prayer from memory. Vertical composition, quiet dignity.

A Black grandmother with close-cropped white hair teaching her granddaughter, about 7, how to fold a paper star. Both look down together at the paper in their hands. Warm and focused. A window with soft light suggested behind them.
A young white woman teacher kneeling down to eye level of a small Latina girl, both of them laughing at something on a piece of paper the girl is holding up. Spontaneous delight, warm connection.
An East Asian boy and a Black girl, both about 8, sitting close together outdoors with their heads bent over a colorful picture book. Soft dappled light. A few simple leaves sketched above.

A young South Asian woman teacher and a small Indigenous boy, about 6, together pressing a seed into the soil in a small clay pot. Both look at the pot. Tender, careful, small-scale moment. A few blades of grass loosely sketched.

A Middle Eastern girl, about 8, holding up her drawing proudly toward an elderly Black man who examines it with great care and delight, leaning in slightly. Simple living room setting suggested with thin pencil lines.

Three children — a Black boy, a white girl, and an East Asian girl, ages 6 to 8 — sitting in a small triangle on a rug, each carefully holding a lit candle. Their faces glow warmly. Quiet, reverent composition.

A young Latina teacher in her twenties leading two small children — one Arab boy, one white girl — in hand movements for a song. All three in motion, arms out, laughing mid-gesture. Outdoors, a few flowers at the edges.

Three girls — South Asian, Black, and mixed heritage — ages 7 to 9, taking turns reading aloud from a picture book. The one reading holds the book up. The others watch with full attention. Sitting on a blanket.

An elderly white woman at a low table with two boys — one Latino, one Pacific Islander, ages 7 and 8 — all bent over a nature journal with pressed flowers on the pages. She points at one flower, both boys lean in to look.

Five children, ages 5 to 10, diverse races, kneeling around a low table drawing. One child, a Black girl, holds up her page proudly. Others still focused on their work. Colorful papers and pencils on the table.
Six children in a garden, watering seedlings together. Some crouching, some standing. Ages 6 to 11, different races. One child holds a watering can. Simple garden rows loosely sketched behind them.

A young Black boy, about 7, sitting at a small table writing careful letters in a notebook. His tongue sticks out slightly in concentration. A pot of flowers sits on the corner of the table.

An older Black girl, about 10, sitting between two younger children — a white boy, 6, and an Arab girl, 7 — helping each of them color their pages. She holds a crayon in one hand and points gently with the other.

Three small children — Latino, Black, East Asian — all 5 or 6 years old, lined up in order to take turns watering a potted plant. The smallest holds the watering can with both hands. Earnest cooperative moment.

Eight children seated in a wide semicircle on the grass, all looking upward at a storyteller's hands visible at the edge of the frame. Faces lit with wonder and concentration. Various ages, mixed races.
